server.description: String value representing the server name, identifier or ip address where the platform is running

errorStr.description: The case insensitive 'contains' filter based on error message

msgDirectionType.description: String value representing msg direction type (incoming to entity or outcoming from entity)

entityId.description: String value representing the entity id in the event body (originator of the message)

entityType.description: String value representing the entity type

msgId.description: String value representing the message id in the rule engine

msgType.description: String value representing the message type

relationType.description: String value representing the type of message routing

dataSearch.description: The case insensitive 'contains' filter based on data (key and value) for the message.

metadataSearch.description: The case insensitive 'contains' filter based on metadata (key and value) for the message.

eventType.description: String value representing the event type
